decisions.reason: Clearly separates clipboard-text projection (InputState.draft, Occurrence.offset/length, chips expand to clipboardText) from detect-coordinate spans used by insertReference/consumeToken (chip = one U+FFFC); normal text/spaces keep normal width.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add; empty composer makes both spaces coincide; after one chip anchor 29 overshoots 2-char detect text, splice no-ops, insertReference false becomes the changed-composer toast; explicitly rejects concurrent-edit and CAS explanations with consistent capture numbers.

Traces unconverted [0,28) span to consumeToken, ignored false, unconditional records.delete; occurrence survives while missing record renders 'unavailable' — both tied to the same coordinate mismatch, not an upload failure.

Gives detectPos(c)=c−Σ(length−1) formula, applies at both call sites (draft-end insert accounting for all preceding occurrences; removal mapped offset with 1-char span), keeps draftRev verbatim, gates records.delete on consumption success.

Two successive pastes with both chips (B2/C2), removal of a chip with another surviving (B7/C4), first/last-chip variants, declined-consumption bookkeeping (B9); asserts composer occurrence, dock chip and record removed together.
